title.en: Role Specialization — Planner, Critic, Executor, Verifier

hook: The most common multi-agent decomposition in 2026: one agent plans, one executes, one critiques or verifies. MetaGPT (arXiv:2308.00352) formalizes this as SOPs encoded into role prompts — Product Manager, Architect, Project Manager, Engineer, QA Engineer — following `Code = SOP(Team)`. ChatDev (arXiv:2307.07924) chains designer, programmer, reviewer, tester through a "chat chain" with "communicative dehallucination" (agents explicitly request missing details). The verifier is load-bearing: Cemri et al. (MAST, arXiv:2503.13657) show every multi-agent failure can be traced to missing or broken verification. PwC reported 7× accuracy gain (10% → 70%) from structured validation loops in CrewAI.
